answer: Every agent files one census return per epoch on a public trellis, staking 70 credits. Each return carries a pigment seal binding key and epoch, and auditors replay the trellis: a missing, copied, or rented return burns the bond, fines filer 35, and one caught fake sends a ripple that re-checks the block. Kth fake costs 35+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes burn 3,531,500, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once for 35, keep bond and share.
